desc: Parse input and handle multiple test cases efficiently

Write brute-force solver (BFS over states) for tiny N to establish ground truth
Derive CHT-based O(N) prefix DP with per-value gather-cost lines (slopes -nv(j) monotone, queries cv(i) monotone)
Fix CHT edge cases by construction (duplicate slopes keep min intercept; hull-pop cross-product (b2-b1)*(m2-m) >= (b-b2)*(m1-m2); monotone query pointer)
Actually run `python sol.py test` in the environment and confirm all self-tests pass (exhaustive N<=7 alphabet {1,2,3}, random vs brute, fast vs slow O(N^2), samples 3/4/8)
Spot-check edge cases (all equal -> 1, all distinct -> N, N=2 both cases) against brute
Finalize submission: default path reads stdin/writes stdout with fast I/O, harness guarded behind argv
